data.one_liner: Open an app’s Play Store or App Store page from a Flutter app
data.what_it_does: This package provides a simple API to launch the Play Store or App Store page for your app. It automatically detects the platform and opens the correct link using url_launcher.
use_when: You want to prompt users to rate or review your app
You need a quick way to link to your app’s store page without custom URL handling
avoid_when: You need to support other app stores or custom deep‑linking
You require advanced analytics or tracking of the link click
strengths: No build_runner or code generation required
weaknesses: Only supports Play Store and App Store
No support for custom URL schemes or analytics
